PCBH is co-located with the Primary Care medical teams, with an emphasis on integration of mental health services within primary care.

This responsibility requires broad-based clinical, administrative and supervisory knowledge and skills. Incumbent works closely and collaboratively with primary care medical teams within their designated clinic locations. Duties may include but are not limited to: 1.

As a full clinical member of the PCBH Team, incumbent conducts initial and comprehensive psychosocial assessments of Veterans referred by the Primary Care providers. They review all data, subjective and objective, and make a clinical assessment, identifying needs and strengths. Effectively uses professional skill, objectivity and insight.

Uses clinical training, insight and experience to interpret data and to identify viable treatment options. Assesses high risk factors, acuity and need for services.

Based on a comprehensive assessment, the incumbent uses professional judgment and advanced practical skills to make a clinical diagnosis and prognosis Treatment provided will be short term, problem focused and part of the care provided by the Patient Aligned Care Team (PACT). 2.

The PCBH Deputy Program Manager provides insightful assessment of cases involving mental health diagnoses, catastrophic medical conditions, dementia, and other high-risk diagnoses and determines if effective treatment can be provided with a short-term intervention or requires a longer term intervention.

Those cases requiring longer term treatment as determined by the incumbent will initially or later be referred to the BHIP or other specialty programs for such treatment (e.g. ADTP, PTSD, MHICM, etc.). 3.

Incumbent coordinates and provides mental health treatment for Veterans assigned to PACT; actively contributes to their PACT teams regarding goals, objectives and interventions for psychosocial and clinical treatment; and recommends adjustments to the Veterans treatment plans and interventions based on any changing needs and/or responses to interventions. 4.

Provides consultation services for primary care providers to maximize the effectiveness of their interventions in reducing health-risk behaviors and enhancing health-promoting behaviors, with a significant emphasis on a prevention-oriented model of care. 5.

The PCBH Deputy Program Manager may consult with other specialists in planning treatment for Veterans with co-morbidities. 6.Provides short term individual, family and group therapy services in accordance with the needs identified in the assessment and treatment plan. 7.Ultimately responsible for all entries in the Veteran's medical record (CPRS) and timely completion thereof, including discharge summaries and patient encounters. 8.Responsible for completion of all assigned clinical reminders for patients under their care, and performance measures assigned to the Care Line.

Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re-specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re-specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: (a) The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA, or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, (b) the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

Wir suchen eine:n Projekmanager:in für unser Projektmanagement Team an unserem Standort in Heidelberg. Werde Teil unseres Teams und baue mit uns das größte KI-gestützte FinTech für das Gesundheitswesen auf!

s.h: Was dich in der Rolle als Projektmanager:in erwartet
s.t:
Du begleitest Arztpraxen vom ersten Tag an - von der technischen Einrichtung über die Schulung des Praxisteams bis zur aktiven Betreuung in den ersten Wochen nach dem Go-live. Dabei übernimmst du echte Verantwortung: Du managst deine Projekte eigenständig, bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Wechsel zu Nelly reibungslos klappt. Kein Tag ist wie der andere – du bist nah an den Menschen, nah am Produkt und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.
Über Nelly
Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann.

Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.
Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.
Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung.

KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.

Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Vertrieb und Technik und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit einem perfekten Start in die Zusammenarbeit mit Nelly durchstarten.
Du führst Implementierungsprojekte von A bis Z: von der technischen Integration über den Produktaufbau bis zur Schulung der Praxisteams (vor Ort & online) und der aktiven Nachbetreuung in der Hypercare-Phase (~30 Tage).
Du erkennst Risiken und Probleme im Projektverlauf frühzeitig, sprichst sie aktiv an und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein.
Du planst, koordinierst und priorisierst deine Aufgaben eigenständig und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Projektverlauf – auch wenn du mehrere Projekte parallel betreust.

Erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder in der Kundenbetreuung – und echte Lust, noch mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
Proaktivität ist für dich selbstverständlich: du denkst mit, fragst nach und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
Starke Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift – ob du 5 oder 40 Personen schulst, du trittst sicher und überzeugend auf.
Strukturiertes Selbst- und Zeitmanagement: du organisierst dich eigenständig, auch wenn viele Projekte gleichzeitig laufen.
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein – insbesondere im Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden-, Zahlungs- und Patientendaten.
Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft (regional, Baden-Württemberg); Führerschein Klasse B.
Teamorientiertes Arbeiten – deine Kolleg:innen können sich auf dich verlassen.
Nice to have: Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, Factoring oder Finance-Umfeld.

The USMC program office and end users responsible for the sustainment and expansion of the West Region Infrastructure LMR ASTRO System require a specialized individual to help support their daily operations. This entails the operation, support, upgrade, protection, and administration of these systems.
Job Description
The Program Manager holds a critical role in overseeing the comprehensive West Region Infrastructure LMR System.

This position encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, including but not limited to managing program personnel and support staff, collaborating with Motorola Sales team members, handling pre and post-sale opportunities and proposals, overseeing the program budget and costs, and providing leadership and direction to Engineers, System Managers, Technologists, Cybersecurity Leads, Customer Service Managers, Quality Managers, Safety Managers, and Configuration Management personnel.

The Program Manager also plays a vital role in ensuring adherence to DoD change management processes, overseeing Project Managers and global projects, managing system upgrades, coordinating with administrative personnel, and effectively communicating and coordinating with customers, partners, the USMC, other branches of the DoD, as well as, internal Motorola personnel and leadership.

Serving as the primary point of contact for the USMC system and the supporting USMC PMO, this position requires a high level of professional experience in executive management, managing large enterprise IT systems, and working with substantial agencies or organizations.

Key skills for success in this role include excellent planning capabilities, prioritization of tasks and responsibilities, adept delegation, exceptional interpersonal communication skills, and proficiency in various other areas.

The Program Manager's contributions are instrumental in the successful implementation and management of the WRI LMR ASTRO System, ensuring efficient operations and effective collaboration across all stakeholders. Knowledge of the Motorola ecosystem is ideal as this role will be the Gatekeeper for all ecosystem opportunities in this space.

Preference will be given to applicants in the Western Region.
Program Manager position is responsible for the management, oversight and overall administration of the ASTRO System which supports the USMC Enterprise LMR system, E911 systems and MBR radios globally.
Oversee and ensure that all contract requirements are met, the systems are maintained at required operational levels and general operation of the entire business.
Responsibilities include personnel management, budgeting and budget administration, business operations, daily communications both internal within Motorola Solutions , Motorola partners, the USMC and other external customers.
Manage supply chain and logistics, strategic planning, customer service, contract management.
Oversee break-fix on the system, preventative maintenance, planning and overseeing all system upgrades and engineering tasks.
Development of policies, SOP's and other written reports, briefings and directives, attending all internal and external meetings and overall responsibility for every aspect of program management, contract management, and meeting all internal and external goals and milestones.
Deliver executive experience with written communications, reports, briefings, creating and maintaining appropriate documentation, problem identification, analysis and resolutions, excellent multi tasking skills, business operations planning and administration
Responsible for leading and ensuring system lifecycle planning, to include hardware, software, and operational data maintenance.
Oversee, lead and direct all logistical planning, change administration and management, preventative maintenance of hardware and software, meeting and maintaining DoD Cybersecurity compliance including Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) compliance and patch management, vulnerability scanning and benchmark testing for the USMC systems when required.
Administer, direct and responsible for system currency, integration of information security for continuous monitoring, system testing, system implementation, updates and support, response and resolution of service calls to provide end to end life cycle sustainment support, management of software licenses and software currency, central monitoring for real-time health and status of the system, equipment repair, asset and configuration management, password management, contract management, auditing and quality assurance, customer relationships, planning and implementation of worldwide System Upgrades, successful development, submission and approval of all CDRL’s and DED’s, approval of Installation Design Plans or similar documentation, approval of system and personnel schedules, actions, requests, hiring and developing, approving and managing employee performance expectations.
Responsible for the successful management of all Motorola projects worldwide that connect to the USMC systems including systems integration projects, service projects and others. Projects include system expansions and upgrades. Upgrades to Dispatch Centers, addition of new sites and other major worldwide projects.
Responsible for approval of all schedules, budgets, invoicing, documents, personnel, directing all work, tasks, contract compliance, ATP’s, SOVT’s, equipment ordering and manufacturing, overseeing project managers and successful management and conclusion of all projects. Responsible for converting all projects to full time sustainment support under this program after project completion.
Ensure that the program strategic plan and goals support and adhere to Motorola strategic goals and objectives, ensure these are clearly communicated to all team members and the program supports these goals and objectives to achieve organizational success.
Work and coordinate daily with Sales to coordinate tasks, responses and strategic direction for the program, as well as, identifying sales opportunities.
Participate in proposals for the USMC, ensuring consistent customer pricing, identifying risks, ensuring all contract requirements are met within the proposal, including approvals, documentation, CDRLs, Information Assurance requirements, engineering design, schedules, resources, and ultimately approving the proposal before it goes to the customer.
Participating in any Engineering Change Board Processes, including submitting all change requests, other required documentation and artifacts, following established procedures, developing and submitting schedules, topography and providing detailed information on system changes.

Veterans shape the future of energy As a Commercialization Program Manager, you will: Organize and administer technology commercialization programs, to include the Technology Commercialization Fund (TCF), to transition laboratory research into the commercial market.

Serve as a senior technical advisor in physical sciences and engineering to evaluate the technical feasibility, maturity, and risks of proposed energy technologies and commercialization projects. Analyze technology-to-market programs to assess their effectiveness, identify performance barriers, and recommend strategic improvements.

Foster collaborative partnerships and coordinate initiatives among national laboratories, plants, sites, other federal and state agencies, and private-sector stakeholders. Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets to ensure milestones are met and program resources are managed efficiently.

Prepare and deliver technical briefs, reports, and presentations to explain complex scientific and engineering concepts and justify program recommendations to senior leadership and external groups.
BASIC REQUIREMENT: You must meet both the Basic Requirement and the Specialized Experience to qualify for this series as described below. A.

Degree: physical science, engineering, or mathematics that included 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science such as mechanics, dynamics, properties of materials, and electronics. OR B.

Combination of education and experience: education equivalent to one of the majors shown in A above that included at least 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-12 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as meeting 2 of the following 3: Provide guidance on technology commercialization, lab-to-market funding programs, energy end-use sectors, or technology maturation processes that advance program objectives.

Act as a technical point of contact to build consensus among corporate partners, research facilities, academic institutions, Tribal organizations and DOE National Laboratories for all joint technology commercialization projects.

Assist with writing briefing materials or reports that are used by management to develop technical recommendations that advance technology commercialization objectives. "Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience.

Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Limit your resume to no more than two (2) pages.

If more than two pages are submitted, only the first two pages will be reviewed to determine your eligibility and qualifications. Your full resume will be made available to the hiring manager if you are referred.

You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

The Pharmacy Inventory Manager is responsible for providing leadership, direction, coordination, clinical guidance, organization, planning, and implementation of pharmaceutical procurement throughout the VA Northern California Healthcare System.

Major Duties include but are not limited to the following: Program Management: Coordinates all activities related to procurement and inventory of all medications, supplies and IV fluids for pharmacy services to include but not limited to receiving, stocking, maintaining inventory, establishing maximum/minimum levels for ordering and automation, rotating stock to minimize expiration and under/overstock, borrowing, returns and destruction.

Monitors and regularly reports status of pharmacy expenditures identifying significant changes, including data and information on specific drugs, therapeutic classes, supplies, etc., that have contributed to the change. Maintains knowledge and competency to appropriately carry out all purchase card duties.

Coordinates with relevant stakeholders and other pharmacy staff to create action plans for drug recalls, shortages, and backorders.

Maintains proficiency in software programs and internet resources related to purchasing, inventory and pharmaceutical care including but not limited to facility automation, electronic health record, prime vendor and other vendor resources, reverse distributor, Federal government, VHA, CMOP, VISN, and local medical center resources, medication dispensing and distribution, drug accountability, controlled substances, IFCAP, vendor files, Fund Control, GIP, purchasing agent menus etc.

Use of Government Credit Cards/Approving Official: Ensures all cardholders and approving officials complete mandatory training. Assures all cards are used appropriately, and/or takes appropriate action when misuse/abuse of purchase card occurs. Establishes cards within the limits of delegated purchase authority.

Immediately cancels card assigned to any employee who separates or is transferred. Assures reconciliation and approvals are completed within the mandated timeframe. Ensures reconciliation is completed prior to a cardholder taking leave or leaving the service. Verifies cardholders perform appropriate market research prior to purchasing.

Ensures proper documentation of records. Certifies all procurements are legal and appropriate. Certification of inappropriate procurements will result in immediate revocation of approving authority, possible disciplinary action and/or issuance of a bill of collection for the full cost of the procurement.

Certifies reconciled (matched) payment charges in IFCAP within 10-days of receipt from cardholder. Administration: Strives to increase productivity and efficiency of assigned personnel and other Pharmacy Service activities to improve processes and pharmaceutical care provided to patients.

Communicates effectively with employees, keeping them informed of necessary information; keeps in close communication with each Section Supervisor regarding drug procurement, drug use, drug accountability, drug budget, etc.

Ensures implementation of pharmacy-based action items as they relate to the facility Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) Committee functions and activities. Assists in meeting all Joint Commission medication management standards by having an expert understanding of regulatory and quality standards for the area of practice.

Ensures accuracy, validity, and timely submission of pharmacy workload activity reports, systematic review/performance improvement reports, operations reports, drug utilization/data reports, and other special reports that are pertinent to the incumbent's program areas.

Research: Participates in the development of protocols for research projects for the Pharmacy Services as appropriate. Enables appropriate distribution of research project information to involve personnel to facilitate the proper handling and use of investigational drugs as appropriate.

Enforces policies and procedures regarding the proper handling, storage, record keeping, and dispensing of investigational drugs, as well as relevant patient monitoring as appropriate for the assigned Pharmacy Section.

Participates in developing criteria for drug utilization evaluations, data collection, trending reports, and other quality assurance activities as required ensuring appropriate and safe drug utilization. s.h: About the role and what you will be doing
s.t:
The Senior Project Manager provides senior-level expertise to plan, organise, control, and deliver large, complex infrastructure and data centre migration projects across Ensono's client portfolio.

Operating within the Global Project and Implementation (GPI) practice, this role manages multiple company-wide initiatives simultaneously — from scope definition and budget planning through to delivery and post-implementation review.

A key part of this position involves building and maintaining strong relationships with client sponsors and internal leaders, including regular on-site engagement at the client's London office.

The Senior Project Manager interfaces directly with client executive management to understand critical business priorities and ensures every project is completed within agreed scope, quality, time, and cost constraints.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure business requirements are clearly defined, understood, and documented

· Define project scope, risks, potential issues, and resource requirements at the outset of each engagement

· Ensure project benefits are realised while managing the impact of organisational change on the business and its clients

· Develop project phases and translate them into clear, measurable project plans

· Communicate internally and externally on delivery of work products, planning activities, and cross-organisational resource relationships

· Manage projects in full adherence to Ensono's project management methodology

· Manage project scope across mission, objectives, and requirements throughout the project lifecycle

· Manage project schedules, including key milestone dates and critical path tracking

· Lead the team in identifying project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; act as the primary escalation point and drive effective mitigation strategies to maintain project goals

· Provide leadership and strategic direction to the project team across all phases of delivery

· Oversee all project work streams, including timeline adherence, quality of deliverables, risk management, issue escalation, and stakeholder collaboration

· Work with all stakeholders to ensure governance frameworks and continuous improvement or transformation plans are established and maintained

· Establish deadlines, assign tasks, and monitor and summarise project progress for all relevant parties

· Develop business insights through analysis of results and communicate key findings to management to support data-driven decision-making

· Secure appropriate resources and personnel in collaboration with management to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget

· Escalate barriers, risks, and issues that may impact timelines or deliverables in a timely and appropriate manner

· Manage the development of polished executive-level presentations and deliver findings to internal associates and external clients clearly and concisely

· Manage project status reporting in line with prescribed timelines for each engagement

· Develop measurement processes and methods to assess progress towards project goals and outcomes

· Manage project costs and budgets throughout the full delivery lifecycle

· Facilitate cross-training to support job rotation and minimise gaps in assignment coverage

· Provide coaching and constructive feedback to all project team members

· Mentor less experienced associates within the project management practice

· Interface with client executive management on-site at the client's London office to understand and address critical business issues and concerns

· Proficient in MS Office and MS Project

· Strong financial management skills, including experience with project budgeting and cost control

· Effective team management skills with the ability to lead matrixed, cross-functional teams

· Strong leadership and strategic direction capabilities

· IT outsourcing knowledge

· Strong infrastructure management experience

· ITIL and/or ITSM knowledge

· Ability to organise and define work in complex or ambiguous situations

· Ability to travel to the client's office in London as required

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or equivalent experience

· Minimum of 7 years of complex IT programme and project management experience

· Demonstrated experience managing large-scale infrastructure and data centre migration projects

· MBA or Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or Engineering preferred

· Project financial and revenue recognition experience preferred

Lucid Labs ist eine spezialisierte Beratung für den deutschen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren operative Entscheidungen, mit angewandter KI und einer eigenen Plattform, die bei Kunden produktiv läuft. Unsere Pipeline wächst schneller als unser Team. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Kundenprojekte übernimmt und in den nächsten zwölf Monaten in die volle Verantwortung für eigene Kunden hineinwächst.
Dabei sind wir besonders stolz auf unsere Geschwindigkeit. Von der Idee bis zum Piloten beim Kunden dauert es bei uns rund eine Woche. Den Hebel, den du im Workshop identifizierst, testet der Kunde nächste Woche als Prototyp. Direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und ohne Layer dazwischen.
Der eigentliche Grund für diese Rolle ist aber ein anderer: Hier wirst du AI-native. Du lernst, KI-Lösungen nicht nur theoretisch zu empfehlen und auf Folien aufzuzeigen, sondern selbst zu bauen, und berätst Unternehmen genau dabei. Das ist der Skill, der in den nächsten Jahren entscheidet, welche Berater gefragt sind. Und kaum ein Ort bringt ihn dir schneller bei als ein Team, das jede Woche selbst baut, was es berät.
Wenn du heute Rollouts, Implementierungen oder Digitalisierungsprojekte betreust und dabei mehr verwaltest als gestaltest: Genau dafür ist diese Rolle gedacht.
Aufgaben
Du übernimmst Kundenprojekte: Discovery, Workshops, laufende Implementierung. In den ersten Wochen gemeinsam mit jemandem, der das schon kann, danach allein. Mehrere Kunden parallel, mit deutlich mehr Tiefe pro Kunde als im klassischen Beratungsgeschäft. Du berichtest direkt an den Gründer und arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering-Team. Das heißt Entscheidungswege von Minuten, nicht von Wochen.
70 % Kundenarbeit: Du bist Ansprechperson für deine Projekte, meist direkt für die Geschäftsführung unserer Kunden. Workshops vorbereiten und leiten, wöchentliche Calls, Demos, Scoping, Anforderungen ins Engineering übersetzen. Dein Maßstab: Deine Kunden arbeiten nach wenigen Wochen messbar anders.
20 % Prototyping: Erste Prototypen baust du selbst, mit modernen AI-Tools und ohne Programmierung. Das ist die Folie, die funktioniert. Wie das geht, lernst du bei uns — und es ist der Teil der Rolle, in dem du am schnellsten wächst.
10 % Pre-Sales & Scoping: Workshops sind bei uns auch ein Sales-Tool. Du bereitest Opportunities mit vor, bist in Angebotsgesprächen dabei und übernimmst mit der Zeit die Folgepotenziale bei deinen eigenen Bestandskunden.
Und weil wir in der Aufbau-Phase sind: Was du in deinen Projekten an Vorlagen, Checklisten und Abläufen entwickelst, wird zum Standard, nach dem das Delivery-Team danach arbeitet.
Deine ersten Monate
In den ersten 6–8 Wochen läufst du in laufenden Projekten mit, übernimmst schrittweise einzelne Workshops und Calls und lernst unsere Tools - nicht in einer Schulung, sondern an echten Kunden, mit jemandem daneben. Nach etwa drei Monaten führst du 2–3 Kundenprojekte selbst, mit einem Sparringspartner im Rücken.

Nach sechs Monaten trägst du deine Kunden allein und kannst Dinge, die du am Anfang nicht konntest: einen Prozess auseinandernehmen, einen Prototyp bauen, eine Geschäftsführerin durch eine Entscheidung führen.
Qualifikation
2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit Kundenkontakt, zum Beispiel als Implementation oder Onboarding Consultant im B2B-SaaS, in der Rollout- oder ERP-Beratung, in einer Digital- oder Prozessberatung, oder als Projektmanager:in / Chief of Staff für Digitalisierungsprojekte im Mittelstand
Mindestens ein Kundenprojekt von Kick-off bis Go-Live getragen, mit deinem Namen am Ergebnis.
Erfahrung damit, selbst vorne zu stehen: Workshops, Schulungen, Anforderungsrunden oder Demos, die du vorbereitet und geleitet hast
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch dann, wenn dir niemand vorgibt, wie die Struktur aussehen soll
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland in Vollzeit. Unsere Kunden sind deutscher Mittelstand, Workshops und Calls laufen auf Deutsch.
Englisch brauchst du auf solidem Arbeitsniveau, weil Tools und Dokumentation englisch sind
Technische Neugier: Du probierst neue Tools selbst aus. ChatGPT oder Claude nutzt du bereits regelmäßig
Was du nicht mitbringen musst: Kein Informatikstudium, keine Coding-Erfahrung, kein abgeschlossenes KI-Projekt, keine Beratungsmarke im Lebenslauf.
Was wir nicht beibringen können: dass du einen Raum hältst, wenn du vorne stehst. Und die Neugier, KI aktiv und wertstiftend einzusetzen. Uns interessiert weniger, wo du startest, als wie schnell du dich bewegst.
Plus, kein Muss: Eigene kleine Builds mit AI-Tools (Claude, n8n, Lovable), Erfahrung mit Kunden aus dem Mittelstand, Pre-Sales-Erfahrung, Change Management.
Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn: du Projekte am liebsten über Monate durchplanst, bevor etwas beim Kunden ankommt. Wenn du Beratung als Analyse verstehst und die Umsetzung anderen überlässt. Wenn du eine fertige Rollenbeschreibung und einen definierten Prozess brauchst, um loszulegen. Oder wenn du Kundengespräche eher meidest als suchst.

AI-native werden. Du baust den Skill auf, den gerade jede Beratung und jedes Unternehmen sucht, und wendest ihn jede Woche bei echten Kunden an. Neue Tools landen bei uns nicht in einer Roadmap, sondern noch in derselben Woche in einem echten Projekt.
Lernen als Teil der Arbeit, nicht daneben. Du arbeitest von Anfang an neben Leuten, die das schon können — im Projekt, nicht im Seminar. Was du fragst, wird beantwortet. Was du baust, bekommt Feedback.
Direkter Impact. Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit den Entscheidern: mit der Geschäftsführung beim Kunden, mit dem Gründer bei uns. Deine Empfehlungen werden umgesetzt, nicht archiviert, und du siehst das Ergebnis innerhalb von Wochen.
Planbare Intensität. Wir arbeiten fokussiert, aber berechenbar: keine Pitch-Wochenenden, keine Sonntag-Final-Edits. Kundenworkshops finden überwiegend remote statt, Reisen sind die Ausnahme.
Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad. Aus dieser Rolle wächst in 12–18 Monaten die volle Verantwortung für eigene Kunden — und danach die Möglichkeit, das Delivery-Team mit aufzubauen.
Ein Gründer, der es schon einmal gemacht hat. Marek war Mitgründer von Flightright, bis zum erfolgreichen Exit.
Remote mit Berlin als Basis. Du arbeitest, wo du willst. Mittwochs treffen wir uns als Team im EDGE Coworking am Hauptbahnhof. Wer weiter weg wohnt, kommt nach Absprache seltener, und wer gern im Office arbeitet, kann jederzeit häufiger da sein.
Wer wir sind
Lucid Labs ist ein AI-first Studio, gegründet von Marek Janetzke. Wir arbeiten selbst so, wie wir beraten: mit Cursor, Claude und den jeweils besten Tools im Alltag. Unsere Kultur: Ownership statt Micromanagement. Lieber in zwei Wochen eine smarte Wette machen und daraus lernen, als drei Monate etwas polieren, das niemand validiert hat. Wir teilen unser Wissen und lernen gleichzeitig gemeinsam als Team. Wir suchen Leute, die mitdenken, nicht nur mitarbeiten.
Bewerbung
Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wenn du schon mal etwas mit AI-Tools gebaut hast, freuen wir uns über einen Link oder Screenshot — Pflicht ist es nicht.

Company Description
Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers.

Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
The Senior Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of Zayo's long haul fiber deployment portfolio through direct oversight of turnkey engineering and construction partners, cross-functional leadership, and governance of multiple concurrent, large-scale infrastructure programs. This role provides both strategic direction and operational execution across complex, multi-million-dollar network expansion initiatives.
The Senior Program Manager owns program governance, capital planning, contractor strategy, executive stakeholder alignment, risk management, and portfolio performance while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Zayo quality standards.
Serving as the primary operational and contractual interface between Zayo, engineering and construction partners, customers, and executive leadership, this position drives organizational alignment across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, GIS, and Network Planning to deliver critical network infrastructure at scale.
This role also leads continuous improvement initiatives, establishes deployment best practices, mentors program managers, and influences long-term deployment strategy across the Long Haul organization.
The Senior Program Manager reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment.

Strategic Program Leadership
Own a portfolio of large-scale long haul deployment programs supporting strategic network expansion initiatives.
Develop portfolio delivery strategies aligned with company growth objectives and capital investment priorities.
Lead cross-functional planning from business case development through engineering, permitting, construction, testing, customer acceptance, and operational turnover.
Establish program governance, delivery standards, performance metrics, and executive reporting across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Balance competing priorities, resources, and funding across multiple programs to optimize delivery performance.
Identify portfolio-level risks and dependencies and proactively implement mitigation and recovery strategies.
Provide recommendations to senior leadership regarding delivery strategy, capital allocation, contractor utilization, and execution priorities.
Executive Stakeholder Leadership
Serve as the executive operational lead for assigned deployment programs.
Build trusted relationships with executive leadership, customers, regulatory agencies, and strategic construction partners.
Lead executive steering committees, program reviews, and customer governance meetings.
Influence cross-functional decision making across Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and Network Planning.
Drive alignment between business objectives and deployment execution across multiple organizations.
Contractor Strategy & Vendor Performance
Develop long-term strategic relationships with turnkey engineering and construction partners.
Lead commercial negotiations for engineering and construction agreements, amendments, and complex change orders.
Establish contractor performance scorecards, KPIs, governance processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Evaluate contractor capacity, financial performance, safety metrics, production trends, and quality performance.
Drive executive-level performance reviews and corrective action plans when contractor performance falls below expectations.
Partner with Procurement and Legal to optimize sourcing strategies and improve contractor performance across the deployment portfolio.
Portfolio Financial Management
Own portfolio-level capital planning, forecasting, and financial performance.
Manage multi-million-dollar capital budgets across numerous concurrent deployment programs.
Lead financial forecasting, variance analysis, accrual management, and executive reporting.
Evaluate commercial impacts of scope changes, schedule adjustments, and risk events.
Partner with Finance to improve forecasting accuracy and optimize capital deployment.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, operational efficiencies, and improved return on investment.
Engineering, Regulatory & Deployment Governance
Provide strategic oversight of engineering, permitting, regulatory compliance, and construction execution.
Partner with Engineering leadership to improve constructability, deployment standards, and network design efficiency.
Oversee compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory requirements including NTIA, NEPA, Section 106, Tribal coordination, Davis-Bacon, BABA, and environmental obligations.
Ensure governance processes support quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and customer commitments across all assigned programs.
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
Lead initiatives to improve deployment processes, governance, reporting, and execution methodologies.
Develop standardized program management tools, dashboards, KPIs, and best practices.
Identify systemic risks and implement scalable operational improvements.
Leverage program data and performance metrics to improve forecasting accuracy, contractor productivity, and deployment efficiency.
Drive lessons learned across the organization to continuously improve delivery performance.
Leadership & Talent Development
Mentor and develop Program Managers, Project Managers, and deployment personnel.
Provide guidance on complex delivery challenges, contractor management, financial controls, and executive communication.
Lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.
Support organizational planning, succession development, and capability building within the Long Haul Deployment organization.

Experience
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, Business, or related field preferred.
Equivalent industry experience may be substituted for formal education.
At least ten (10) years of telecommunications, fiber deployment, infrastructure, or OSP program management experience.
At least eight (8) years leading complex outside plant construction programs and contractor organizations.
Demonstrated success leading portfolios of multimillion-dollar infrastructure deployments.
Experience managing EPC, engineering, and construction contracts.
Experience managing federally funded broadband programs and associated regulatory compliance.
Experience leading cross-functional organizations through complex delivery challenges.
Experience presenting to executive leadership and customer stakeholders.

Il mercato dei media e pubblicitario sta cambiando più rapidamente che mai. Con te diamo forma al futuro!

* Insieme alla direzione ti occuperai dello sviluppo di strategie, modelli di business e iniziative di crescita per il futuro del mercato dei media e pubblicitario.
* Gestirai progetti e programmi rilevanti dal punto di vista strategico, dalla concezione fino alla loro attuazione, compresa la gestione dei costi, dei rischi, della qualità e delle scadenze.
* Analizzerai le tendenze del mercato, della clientela, della concorrenza e della tecnologia, ricavandone opportunità commerciali concrete e raccomandazioni operative.
* Elaborerai in autonomia solide basi decisionali, business case e documenti strategici per la direzione e altri responsabili decisionali.
* Identificherai tempestivamente i potenziali di innovazione, ottimizzazione e crescita e ne promuoverai attivamente l-attuazione.
* Collaborerai a stretto contatto con la direzione, le unità specializzate e i partner esterni, garantendo un-attuazione efficace dei progetti strategici.
* Con nuove idee e nuovi impulsi promuoverai l-innovazione, la trasformazione e il miglioramento continuo e darai slancio ai cambiamenti.
**Le tue competenze**
* Vanti un-esperienza pluriennale nella consulenza strategica, nel Corporate Development, nell-Inhouse Consulting o in una funzione analoga, preferibilmente con conoscenze del settore dei media, della pubblicità, della tecnologia o delle piattaforme.
* È richiesta una laurea in economia aziendale con specializzazione in strategia, trasformazione, sviluppo aziendale, informatica gestionale o discipline affini.
* Hai già guidato con successo progetti, programmi o iniziative di trasformazione rilevanti dal punto di vista strategico.
* Ti contraddistinguono spiccate capacità analitiche e concettuali, una rapida capacità di comprensione e un pensiero sistemico.
* Sei in grado di convincere grazie a un atteggiamento sicuro e adeguato al livello gerarchico, ad abilità diplomatica e a una comunicazione efficace, adattata alle diverse interlocutrici e ai diversi interlocutori.
* Agisci con spirito imprenditoriale, lavori in modo strutturato e dai importanza alle soluzioni pragmatiche.
* Hai una buona conoscenza di una prima lingua nazionale a livello scritto e orale e una buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca e dell-inglese.
Al fine di promuovere la diversità linguistica e di genere, siamo particolarmente lieti di ricevere candidature da parte di donne o persone che parlano francese o italiano.

Nosso objetivo - Potencializar os negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis. Topa vir com a gente nessa? 🎯
Sobre a posição
Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Technical Project Manager , responsável pela condução de projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , combinando gestão de projetos, relacionamento com stakeholders e sólida capacidade técnica.
A posição terá papel central na conexão entre negócio, produto e tecnologia, garantindo clareza de escopo, planejamento, alinhamento entre equipes e qualidade das decisões técnicas ao longo do projeto.
Esperamos uma pessoa com experiência relevante em e-commerce B2C e B2B , conhecimento avançado da plataforma VTEX e capacidade para participar ativamente da definição de arquiteturas de solução e integrações. Perfil esperado
Procuramos uma pessoa que não atue apenas no acompanhamento operacional do projeto. O Technical Project Manager deve possuir profundidade técnica suficiente para compreender as soluções propostas, questionar decisões, identificar riscos e conduzir discussões de arquitetura , sem necessariamente assumir a responsabilidade pela implementação.
Também esperamos forte capacidade de relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders, organização para atuar em ambientes complexos e habilidade para transformar discussões técnicas e de negócio em planos de execução claros e objetivos.
Principais responsabilidades
Planejar e conduzir projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , acompanhando escopo, cronograma, riscos, dependências e entregas.
Atuar como principal ponto de conexão entre stakeholders de negócio, times técnicos e demais áreas envolvidas no projeto.
Gerenciar escopo, prioridades e expectativas, conduzindo negociações com stakeholders quando houver mudanças, riscos ou conflitos de prioridade.
Conduzir cerimônias e processos de desenvolvimento utilizando Scrum e metodologias ágeis .
Estruturar planos de trabalho, acompanhar evolução das entregas e garantir visibilidade clara sobre status, riscos e próximos passos.
Traduzir necessidades de negócio em direcionamentos compreensíveis para os times técnicos.
Participar da definição e revisão de arquiteturas de solução , considerando requisitos funcionais, integrações, escalabilidade e restrições da plataforma.
Conduzir agendas técnicas relacionadas a arquiteturas de integração e fluxo de dados entre VTEX, ERPs, CRMs, OMS, sistemas de pagamento, logística, marketplaces e demais plataformas corporativas.
Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, desenvolvedores e especialistas para avaliar alternativas técnicas e apoiar decisões de solução.
Garantir alinhamento entre arquitetura, escopo acordado e objetivos de negócio.
Identificar antecipadamente riscos técnicos ou funcionais que possam impactar prazo, escopo ou qualidade da solução.
Organizar e conduzir workshops, refinamentos técnicos, sessões de discovery e alinhamentos de arquitetura.
Estruturar roteiros de demonstração , preparando cenários que evidenciem as principais capacidades e entregas do projeto.
Realizar demos, apresentações executivas e reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, lideranças e diretorias.
Comunicar temas técnicos de forma clara para públicos não técnicos, contextualizando impactos, riscos e decisões.

Excelente capacidade de comunicação, organização e planejamento .
Experiência comprovada na gestão e condução de projetos enterprise .
Experiência prática com Scrum e metodologias ágeis .
Experiência com gestão de escopo, riscos, dependências e negociação com stakeholders.
Experiência com projetos de e-commerce B2C e B2B .
Inglês fluente , com capacidade para conduzir reuniões, apresentações e discussões técnicas.
Conhecimento técnico avançado da plataforma VTEX e de seus principais componentes e capacidades.
Conhecimento técnico avançado suficiente para elaborar, discutir e validar arquiteturas de solução .
Experiência com arquiteturas de integração entre plataformas de e-commerce e sistemas corporativos.
Capacidade de compreender APIs, integrações, eventos, fluxos de dados e dependências entre sistemas.
Experiência conduzindo reuniões técnicas com arquitetos, desenvolvedores, equipes de integração e stakeholders de negócio.
Capacidade de produzir materiais executivos e apresentar soluções, entregas e decisões para públicos de liderança.

Dans notre centre de développement à Wil SG, nous réalisons des produits pour des moyennes et grandes séries et développons des technologies pour des entreprises de pointe, orientées vers l'avenir, à l'échelle mondiale.
Pour soutenir notre équipe de logiciels embarqués dans le développement de dispositifs médicaux et de diagnostics in vitro ainsi que pour des tâches générales dans le domaine du développement logiciel et firmware, nous recherchons un chef de projet.
### Domaine d'activité ###
En tant que personne orientée vers les objectifs avec une expertise technique approfondie, vous supervisez le développement et la mise en œuvre de firmwares et logiciels dans un environnement réglementé pour des applications médicales ou industrielles. En tant que membre expérimenté de l'équipe, vous êtes responsable de la gestion de projet pour la mise en œuvre et l'intégration des firmwares et logiciels avec la qualité requise et conformément au processus de développement.
Vous travaillez au sein d'une équipe d'ingénieurs logiciels hautement qualifiés, d'électroniciens embarqués et de développeurs firmware. Votre motivation et votre méthode de travail structurée vous permettent de mettre en œuvre des solutions technologiques avec efficacité.

* Recueillir les exigences techniques des demandes clients
* Planifier les projets de développement firmware/logiciel en tenant compte des objectifs techniques, financiers et de délais (gestion de projet hybride, avec périmètre, calendrier et budget définis)
* Négocier avec les clients et présenter les résultats
* Coordonner et communiquer en interne ainsi qu'avec les clients
* Diriger vos projets de manière autonome, gérer et motiver l'équipe de développement en respectant les processus et objectifs requis
* Implémenter de nouvelles technologies et méthodes de mise en œuvre
* Éventuellement esquisser initialement l'architecture logicielle / modularisation comme base pour l'estimation des efforts
* Soutenir l'acquisition de clients et prendre la tête de la préparation des offres
### Exigences ###
* Diplôme d'une haute école technique (FH/ETH) et plusieurs années d'expérience en développement de logiciels embarqués/firmware
* Plusieurs années d'expérience en gestion de projet et collaboration dans des équipes interdisciplinaires
* Expérience significative en ingénierie logicielle et système ainsi qu'en architecture
* Curiosité et recherche constante de nouvelles façons d'améliorer ou d'élargir votre efficacité et vos compétences
* Habitude de travailler dans un environnement dynamique orienté client et d'agir en tant qu'interlocuteur compétent auprès des collaborateurs et clients
